The **Systems Ethology Platform** (`ewingApp()`) serves as the central interactive hub for the `ewing` simulation package. Based on `inst/shinyApp/app.R`, it integrates species parameter initialization, event-driven competing risk transitions, substrate interactions, temperature regime Splines, and multi-run confidence envelope estimations.

## Interactive Application Usage

You can launch the full Systems Ethology interactive application natively in R:

```r
library(ewing)

# Launch central Shiny app
ewingApp()
```

> [!NOTE]
> **Live Deployment:** The full interactive Systems Ethology application is deployed live on [Posit Connect (SystemsEthology)](https://connect.doit.wisc.edu/SystemsEthology).

---

## Workflow Example: Host-Parasite Simulation Run

Below is a demonstration of initializing a simulation community (200 hosts, 100 parasites) and projecting host-parasite interactions across 4,000 discrete event steps using core `ewing` engine functions.

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig.width: 9
#| fig.height: 6

library(ewing)
library(ggplot2)

# 1. Initialize simulation community (default 200 hosts, 100 parasites)
mysim <- init.simulation()

# 2. Run simulation engine for 4,000 steps
simres <- future.events(mysim, nstep = 4000, refresh = 500, plotit = FALSE)

# 3. Visualize age class distributions and spatial substrate allocation
plot(simres)
```

---

## Platform Components & Architecture

The platform combines modular Shiny components (`ewingInput`, `ewingOutput`, `ewingServer`) defined in [`R/ewingApp.R`](file:///Users/brianyandell/Documents/Research/ewing/ewing/R/ewingApp.R) and deployed via [`inst/shinyApp/app.R`](file:///Users/brianyandell/Documents/Research/ewing/ewing/inst/shinyApp/app.R):

1. **Parameter Initialization (`initParApp`)**: Configure species life stage durations, attack rates, and reproduction probabilities.
2. **Simulation Engine (`simApp`)**: Execute competing-risk event queues on leftist tree structures.
3. **Dynamic Visualizations (`distPlotApp`, `substrateApp`, `envPlotApp`)**: Monitor real-time stage distributions, spatial agent positions, and multi-run variance envelopes.
4. **Spatial & Hexagonal Integration (`hexmapApp`)**: Project abstract substrate coordinates onto real-world USGS watershed geography.
